newsitem.title: USA: Transocean says will offer $300 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Transocean says will offer $300 mln in debt.

text.p: Transocean Offshore Inc said Friday it will offer $300 million principal amount of senior, unsecured debt securities in an underwritten public offering.

The company said the securities consist of $100 million principal amount of notes due 2027, subject to an option by the holders to have all or a portion of the notes repaid on the anniversary of the issuance thereof in 2007.
The company also said the securities consist of $200 million principal amount of debentures due 2027.
The company said notes and debentures will be issued under a shelf registration statement covering an aggregate $750 million of securities.
The company said the underwriters for the offering are Goldman, Sachs & Co, Salomon Brothers Inc, ABN AMRO Chicago Corporation and Credit Lyonnais Securities Inc.
The company said it will use the proceeds from the offering to repay debt under its bank credit facility, which has a maturity date of July 30, 2002.
